verses.text: A psalm by David, when he fled from his son Absalom. LORD, my enemies keep growing in number! So many are rising up against me.
So many say about me, “God won’t help him.” Selah.
But you, LORD, are a shield around me. You are my glory, the one who lifts my head.
I cry aloud to the LORD, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah.
I lay down and slept. I woke up again because the LORD keeps me safe.
I won’t be afraid, even if tens of thousands surround me on every side.
Rise up, LORD! Save me, my God! You’ve struck all my enemies in the face and broken the teeth of the wicked.
Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing rest on your people. Selah.
